name: agent-orb
title: Agent Orb
description: An animated agent orb for React and shadcn, showing whether an assistant is idle, listening, thinking or speaking.

meta.details: A small living orb for an assistant's state: colour fields drift inside a glassy sphere and it breathes, idle, listening, thinking or speaking, with its speed tied to the token rate so it keeps pace with the stream.

docs: Import AgentOrb from components/eased/agent-orb/agent-orb. Feed rate from useTokenRate (eased-thinking-core) to tie its speed to your stream.
